title: Warehouse Management System (WMS)
description: A comprehensive web application for warehouse logistics supporting inventory tracking across hierarchical storagelocations (zones, racks, shelves, pallets, and bins). Features inbound/outbound order verification, automated stock alerts, and a normalized PostgreSQL schema to efficiently manage products and internal stock movements.
features: Developed a warehouse web application to track real-time inventory across multiple zones, shelves, and bins.
Designed a PostgreSQL schema to manage products, batches, suppliers, and internal stock movements efficiently.
Implemented inbound/outbound order verification flows and automated stock alerts for expiring materials.
Built a clear and responsive management dashboard using Laravel Blade and Tailwind CSS.

title: SecureSign (Digital Signature System)
description: A secure full-stack web tool for uploading PDF files, generating digital signatures, and validating document authenticity. Utilizes RSA cryptography for secure key generation and features PostgreSQL JSONB event logging to track user actions and maintain cryptographic audit trails.
features: Built a full-stack web tool for uploading PDF files, generating embedded digital signatures (PAdES), and validating document authenticity.
Applied RSA cryptography algorithm for secure key generation to prevent document tampering.
Utilized FastAPI and SQLAlchemy to handle user signing flows, integrated with Supabase for robust cloud storage and deployment compatibility.
Implemented event logging via PostgreSQL JSONB to track user actions, IP records, and cryptographic audit trails.

title: Fast Food POS System
description: A comprehensive Point of Sale system tailored for fast-food restaurants. Features real-time kitchen order processing, inventory tracking, staff role management, and detailed sales analytics.
features: Developed a full-stack Point of Sale (POS) management system tailored for restaurants to streamline sales, table booking, and order processing.
Built a responsive frontend using ReactJS, Vite, and TailwindCSS, incorporating dynamic dashboard analytics, customer feedback loops, and QR code integration.
Designed a secure RESTful API with NestJS, utilizing JWT and bcrypt to handle authentication and sign-in sessions.
Implemented role-based client-side routing and dynamic UI rendering to seamlessly direct Admin, Staff, and Kitchen accounts to their respective management views.
Automated invoice generation, and state-driven table status management (Active, Locked, In-use, Reserved).

title: SmartDoc AI (Local Document RAG)
description: A local Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) tool designed to parse, analyze, and query offline documents. Integrates local Large Language Models via Ollama and FAISS for efficient vector storage and highly accurate text retrieval.
features: Developed a local Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) tool to parse, analyze, and query offline documents.
Integrated local Large Language Models via Ollama and FAISS for efficient vector storage and accurate text retrieval.
Optimized prompt engineering for reliable text extraction from complex data formats.

title: SoundWave (Audio Streaming Platform)
description: An audio streaming platform developed using a Monorepo structure, featuring synchronized media playback. Includes a robust relational database designed with Prisma to systematically manage users, music tracks, and public playlists, fully secured by JWT authentication and refresh mechanisms.
features: Developed an audio streaming platform using a Monorepo structure, featuring synchronized media playback.
Designed a robust relational database with Prisma to systematically manage users, music tracks, and public playlists.
Fully secured the application via robust JWT authentication and token refresh mechanisms.

title: TechZone E-Commerce
description: A full-stack e-commerce platform dedicated to electronic devices (concept similar to The Gioi Di Dong). Includes advanced product filtering, secure cart management, user authentication, and a robust admin dashboard.
features: Built a full-stack e-commerce platform dedicated to electronic devices.
Implemented advanced product filtering, secure cart management, and user authentication.
Developed a robust admin dashboard for complete inventory and order management system.

title: Phone Store Management System
description: A desktop-based phone store management system built with Java Swing and MySQL, featuring inventory management, invoicing, warranty tracking, role-based access control, employee management, and business statistics visualization following the MVC architecture.
features: Developed a desktop-based phone store management system built with Java Swing and MySQL following the MVC architecture.
Implemented comprehensive inventory management, invoicing, and warranty tracking features.
Integrated role-based access control, employee management, and business statistics visualization.
